title: Startup Battlefield 200 applications close in days: Apply before May 27
description: The deadline to apply or nominate for Startup Battlefield 200 is May 27. This is your shot at VC access, global visibility, TechCrunch coverage, and $100,000. Apply now.
summary_cn: TechCrunch的Startup Battlefield 200创业竞赛申请截止日为5月27日，面向AI等领域初创公司。入选者可获得VC对接、全球曝光、TechCrunch报道及10万美元奖励。对AI产品经理而言，这是了解前沿AI产品创新和商业模式的机会，也可作为自身项目获取资源、加速落地的跳板。
